html:
SMTO-CTX-0039 — The task tried to use notes that belong to another task

GUID: a1be0643-79b0-58e7-b968-d011dbffff50
Slug: task-context-scope-unavailable
Domain: CTX · Subsystem: task-context

What happened

  • Each task has its own working notes. This request either had no notes available to it or pointed at notes from a different task, so SMTO refused it. Nothing was read or changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Let the task continue; it is told to use its own notes and list what is available. The task can find a valid note in its own notes without your help.
  2. If you asked it to use notes or results from another task, select Steer and paste or describe the needed details instead. A task can't open another task's notes directly, but it can use what you give it.
  3. If the work belongs with an earlier task, use Continue in new conversation on that ended task instead. This carries a summary of that task forward so the new work can build on it.

What success looks like

  • The task reads its own notes or uses the details you gave it and continues.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't change access settings to let one task read another's notes.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A Task Context operation has no available bound notebook for this run or conversation, or the referenced source belongs to another scope (notebook_unavailable, source_scope_mismatch or task_context_unavailable).

What this means

  • The operation has no available bound notebook or the source belongs to another scope. The recorded reason and operation message identify the specific condition.

Why this can happen

  • The run or conversation scope required for notebook access is unavailable.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the operation, reason, revision and source reference recorded by the producer.

How to fix it

  • Use the current run's notebook and a reference observed in this scope (list it again if needed); references from another task or conversation are not valid here. If the run has no bound notebook, check that the Task Context capability is attached to the run; do not bypass the scope check.
  • Use the current task notebook and an observed reference accessible in that scope. Do not reuse references from another task.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the indicated argument or refresh the source first; retain existing access checks and revision checks.

How to verify the fix

  • The corrected notebook operation succeeds.

What not to do

  • Do not bypass source access checks or overwrite a revision conflict.

Technical notes

  • An unavailable source does not prove that no relevant information exists.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-CTX-0028 — SMTO couldn't find an item in this Task's saved notes
